_meta.description: The cash flow category of a balance sheet account (design D1, REQ-RCF-001). Named zz- so its Account version is the last one merged.

cashFlowCategory.title: Cash flow category
cashFlowCategory.description: Where a movement on this balance sheet account goes in the cash flow statement: cash (the change the statement explains), working capital (operating), fixed assets (investing), financing or equity (financing). Revenue and expense accounts need none. A balance account without one shows as unclassified.
